How does teak wilt affect the economic value of teak wood?

Teak wilt leads to brown discoloration, undermining the wood’s aesthetic and structural qualities. These defects lower the commercial value, as discolored wood is less desirable in markets prioritizing visual appeal and durability. Consequently, teak growers face economic losses due to reduced quality and marketability of the affected timber.
